progress.$description: Component-level tokens for determinate progress indicators — bars and rings. Progress state is never signalled by color alone: every state token pairs with a required icon and text label, named in its description. Ported from finance's design-tokens package and re-expressed against Studio's t-shirt spacing and radius scales.

track.$description: Unfilled portion of a bar or ring.

fill.$description: Filled portion, for progress that carries no status meaning.

height.$description: Bar thickness at the default size.

height-lg.$description: Bar thickness when the bar is the primary element of a card.

radius.$description: Fully rounded ends on both the track and the fill.

stroke.$description: Ring stroke width. Matches the default bar height so the two read as one component family.

duration.$description: Fill transition. Uses the shared state duration, so it collapses to 1ms under prefers-reduced-motion along with everything else.

label-muted.$description: Secondary label — percentage, remaining amount, or description.

on-track.$description: Progressing as expected. Requires a success icon and a text label; color alone is not sufficient.

at-risk.$description: Approaching a limit or deadline. Requires a warning icon and a text label naming the threshold.

exceeded.$description: Past the limit. Requires an icon and a text label stating the overage.

pending.$description: Indeterminate or awaiting data. Requires an icon and a text label; do not animate indefinitely without one.

complete.$description: Finished. Distinguished from on-track by its icon and label, not by color — the two share a value deliberately.
